## 兼容与限制

- 要求 **DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.1**（`package.json#dsh.engines`）：宿主半边依赖 `webserver/index-inject`
  的行渲染行为与 `webServer.register` 的原始 `(req, res)` 契约
- 只能在 **Web UI 加载之后**覆盖全屏，做不到早于 Electron 窗口首帧（窗口本身仍有一瞬间空白）
- 首帧是一块**纯色**（`#000000`），不是视频的第一帧画面——它只负责在插件求值前占住屏幕
- 网页版**不可能**自动播放还带声音：浏览器拦未静音自动播放，只能静音起步、点一下开声
- 视频文件随包走（不是内联 base64），由宿主路由流式返回，支持 Range / 206 / 304

## 素材与许可

**代码 MIT。**

**内置素材分两段，授权状态不同，发布包只带第一段：**

| 素材 | 来源 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/hdd.mp4`（HDD 开机动画） | B 站 UP 主 **[@露霁luki_yo](https://space.bilibili.com/3537104783018790)** 的《Hollow Deep Dive System》(HDD) | ✅ **已获作者授权**，可随包分发 |
| `assets/yuedu.mp4`（欢迎来到月读世界） | 从电影片段剪出的几秒 | ⛔ **未获授权**——只在本机自用，**不进发布包** |

所以对外发布的那份只有 HDD 一段（用 `npm run pack:release` 打，见下）。
`yuedu.mp4` 不在仓库里，你自己那份请保留在 `assets/`，本地两段都能用。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [视频开屏方案.md](../视频开屏方案.md) | 立项方案：路线对比、素材实测、限制清单（本机文档，不在仓库内） |
| [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) | 版本记录 |

## 致谢

- **HDD 开机动画素材由 B 站 UP 主 [@露霁luki_yo](https://space.bilibili.com/3537104783018790) 授权提供**——
  《Hollow Deep Dive System》(HDD) 是他的作品，插件内置的那段片头就是它（压缩与裁边见 `scripts/make-asset.mjs`）。
- 首帧抢屏与"盖住开机卡片"的做法，最初由 [dsh-550c-boot](https://github.com/yannicksong0106/dsh-550c-boot)
  （Ziyang Song / Voidpoket）验证并记录；本插件沿用同一套宿主契约。

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Manually resume an interrupted DSH conversation: /continue and an action-row action pick the run up exactly where it stopped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-continuechat

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Manually resume an interrupted DeepSeek Harness conversation.

When a turn ends early — stopped by hand, cut short by a failed model request, or truncated by the output-token limit — the harness leaves nothing behind but a "stopped" marker. This plugin adds the missing step: a `/continue` command and a **Continue** action in the action row under the interrupted reply itself, so the run picks up exactly where it stopped instead of restarting.

## What it solves

| Situation | Without the plugin | With the plugin |
|---|---|---|
| You hit stop by accident | Retype "continue" yourself | Click **Continue** |
| A network or provider failure aborted the turn | Restate the context before the model resumes | The plugin hands the recorded failure to the model and resumes |
| The reply was cut off by the token limit | The harness says *send "continue"* — with no entry point | One click or one command continues the answer |

## Usage

### Command

```
/continue
/continue also fix the remaining three files
```

Text after the command name is appended to the continuation prompt as an "Additional instruction from the user" line.

The command's outcome (`已请求继续对话（中断原因：手动停止）。`) is rendered by the harness command plane; it never becomes a model message.

### Button

On the turn that was cut short, a **Continue** action appears in the action row under the closing assistant message — the same row that carries copy / thumbs-up / thumbs-down / branch:

- **It only appears on a real interruption.** Turns that completed, were blocked, or merely closed a fork show nothing, so the button never shows up under a conversation that ended normally.
- Only the assistant message that closes that turn carries it; every other message renders nothing and takes no space.
- It disappears again once the agent is running.
- Clicking it is exactly one `/continue` execution.
- A failed attempt keeps a short error line next to the action (hover for the full text).

The decision comes from the session's durable event window: the newest `turn/end` must have a resumable reason *and* that turn must carry a **persistent** assistant message. A turn that was interrupted **before producing any assistant output** (a request that failed outright, a process that died before streaming) therefore has nowhere to host the button — use the `/continue` command there.

### Command menu

Type `/` and pick `continue` ("Continue the interrupted conversation from where it stopped"). Arrow keys plus Enter are enough — no draft typing required.

## How it works

### Interruption tracking (host half)

The plugin subscribes to the session log's `session/event` and tracks every turn end:

| `reason.kind` | Meaning | Resumable |
|---|---|---|
| `aborted` | Run cancelled. `reason.reason.kind` refines it: `user` stopped by hand, `parent` stopped by a parent operation, `hook` stopped by a harness hook, `disposed` session torn down | ✅ |
| `error` | Model request failed (network, auth, server) | ✅ |
| `max-tokens` | Reply truncated by the output-token limit (not a context-window overflow) | ✅ |
| `interrupted` | Turn closed by crash recovery after the host process was interrupted | ✅ |
| `completed` | Finished normally | ❌ |
| `blocked` | Step refused by `agent/pre-step` before entering | ❌ |
| `forked` | Fork seed closing an inherited prefix (the start of a new session) | ❌ |

Any later `user/message` clears the record — either the user took over, or the plugin already resumed the run.

### The continuation prompt

`/continue` does not send a bare "continue". It queues a structured user message:

```
<continue-conversation>
The previous turn ended early: the run was stopped by hand.
Continue the interrupted work in this same session, from exactly where it stopped:
- Do not restart the task, re-summarize, or repeat output and work that is already visible above.
- Treat the current workspace, tool results, and durable session state as authoritative; …
- If a tool call was interrupted, verify its outcome before retrying it, and never blindly retry an operation that may have side effects.
- Finish the remaining work, then verify the result before reporting it.
Failure recorded by the harness: <what the harness logged when the turn died>
Additional instruction from the user: <text typed after the command>
</continue-conversation>
```

The first line is rewritten per reason (stopped by hand / request failed / reply cut off / crash recovery), and the harness-recorded failure text is attached so the model knows *why* the turn ended — which is what decides between continuing to write and re-checking an interrupted tool call first.

### Why the answer is a separate message

After you press **Continue**, DSH opens a new turn for the model to write on, and the plugin then retires that turn's trigger prompt from the transcript — so you no longer see the prompt, and the interrupted reply is followed directly by the new text.

The retirement is a `system/message` replacement, and the log makes such an event *step-scoped*: its `turn`/`step` must name the step that is open as it lands, and both coordinates must be positive (`dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js`, `assertV4SystemMessageFields` plus the relationship replay). A turn that has already ended names no open step, so the replacement cannot be written there. It rides the step that produced the model's answer to the prompt — or, for a turn that produced none, the next step that opens.

The new text **cannot be merged into the original message**. That is an architectural constraint of the DSH session log, not an implementation shortcut:

- The log is event-sourced: a committed assistant message cannot be edited, only shadowed by a surface `replace`.
- A `replace` must list every shadowed node in `sourceEventSeqs` (`dsh-session/lib/index.js:327`), while `assistant/message` is explicitly forbidden from carrying that field (`:313`, it embeds its provider stream). The two rules conflict, so no assistant event can perform a replacement.
- Shadowing the whole range with a `system/message` instead would also shadow the `tool/call` / `tool/result` pairs inside it, breaking the model history so the next request fails.

The provider side has no assistant prefill either (`dsh-llm-deepseek` carries only anthropic-beta flags), so the model cannot literally continue the previous assistant message — it must generate a new one.

The result: **no stray "continue" prompt, but still a separate new answer.**

### Message shape

The continuation message is built by hand as `{ id, role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text }], source: { kind: 'continue-chat' } }` and frozen:

- **The `id` is mandatory.** `Agent.inbox` deduplicates pending messages by `message.id` (a duplicate throws `already pending`) and never mints one, so the plugin generates it with `randomUUID()` from `node:crypto`.
- **`source.kind` is `continue-chat`.** Chat classifies a `user/message` by its source kind: `user` would render the prompt as a human bubble, while any other kind renders it as an injected-context node — and a context node whose content is plain text stays out of the visible node set. Never use `'plugin'` either: that is only the legacy format-v3 shape and format v4 rejects it when reading a log back.
- As a result the host half imports **nothing but `node:crypto`**: no `peerDependencies`, and therefore no exposure to the plugin version-compatibility gate.

### The browser half

The client half does exactly two things:

1. Registers the `continue-chat` dictionaries (zh/en).
2. Registers one action in the `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` slot. That slot's owner prop is `messageId` and its entries render inside Chat's `MessageIconActions` — the very component that owns copy / rating / branch — so the button lands in that row by construction.

Clicking it runs `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, '/continue', [])`, the same path a hand-typed `/continue` takes, so command lifecycle records, result rendering, and logging all stay identical.

Whether a message belongs to an interrupted turn is answered by the session's own durable event window: `ctx.s

plugins.description: Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — npm: dsh-tavily-cxykyw
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tavily-cxykyw

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes from a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request. Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. > Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is published as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`. ## What it does - registers a search provider with the stable id **`tavily`** on `ctx.web`; - maps Tavily's response to DSH's normalized `WebSearchResult` — `results[].url/title/content` become `sources[].url/title/snippet`, and Tavily's optional `answer` becomes the result `content`; - resolves the API key on **every** search, in this order: literal `apiKey` → credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) → launch environment / `process.env`; - `available()` is a cheap local check (key + base URL present) with no network calls — a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` at search time; - then truncates to `request.maxResults` through the seam, exactly like any other provider. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw ``` If your DSH profile is a pnpm workspace root (the default `~/.dsh/profiles/web` is), the add must target the workspace root: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding the package also registers it as a profile bundle: the provider row is inserted **and** `web.searchProvider` is set to `tavily` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — bundle changes are not hot-reloaded. From a checkout instead of npm: ```sh git clone https://github.com/cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-search-tavily -w ``` ## Configure the API key Get a key at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) (there is a free tier). Then pick **one** of: **1. Credentials file (recommended — outside every repository):** ```yaml # ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` **2. Environment variable** of the process that launches DSH: ```sh TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx dsh web ``` **3. Literal key in your own profile patch** (works, but keeps the secret in a plain file — prefer 1 or 2): ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: apiKey: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` > **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarball contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine at search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`. ## Options Configurable on the inserted `web-search-tavily` row: | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. | | `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. | | `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). | | `searchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). | | `maxResults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. | Example, overriding just the depth and result count: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: searchDepth: advanced maxResults: 5 ``` ## Switching providers The bundle patch already pins the seam: ```yaml - id: web config: searchProvider: tavily fetchProvider: http ``` To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no pin, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`). > Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice. ## Notes and limitations - No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is configured through the profile patch only. - `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`. - Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set. ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` ## License MIT © cxykyw

plugins.description: 深鲸画布 · DSH 插件：把一段文字变成能发的视频。稿子、素材、成片都在你自己的电脑上，不上传、不联网。免费版可用。
plugins.readme_text:
# 深鲸画布 · DSH 插件

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-shell-canvas)

把一段文字，变成能发的视频。

贴一段稿子、选几张素材，点一下出横竖双版成片。
**稿子、素材、成片都在你自己的电脑上** —— 不上传、不联网，拔掉网线照样出片。

## 安装

在你所用的、支持 DSH 的载体里打开「插件管理器」，选择**从压缩包安装**，选中下载好的 `.tgz` 即可。

命令行安装：

```bash
# 推荐：从 npm 装（始终取最新版，不钉版本号）
dsh plugin add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-shell-canvas
```

也可以从官网下载插件包后，在插件管理器里「从压缩包安装」：
<https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/download.html>


装完无需重启，界面跟随所在载体的外观。

## 能力

- **一次出三种版式** —— 旁白口播 / 金句引用 / 步骤清单，编排各不相同
- **逐句指定配图** —— 分镜表里逐句安排素材与时长，素材与字幕一一对应
- **一个位置放多张图或一段视频** —— 多图按时间轮播；视频素材会让画面真的动起来
- **每个镜头换版位** —— 尺寸、位置、入场方式逐镜轮换
- **一次出横竖双版** —— 同一份稿子，横版竖版一起给
- **模型不绑任何一家** —— 生图与配音接你自己的接口，密钥留在本机
- **批量出片** —— 一次丢进一整批；一条出错不拖垮整批
- **跨平台** —— macOS / Windows / Linux

## 授权

| | |
|---|---|
| **免费版** | **不限条数**出片，成片带水印，直接下载就能用，不用注册 |
| **授权版** | ¥199/年，去掉水印 + 批量出片 + 每条可查 |

有效期 1 年，期间不限出片次数。授权码按时间到期，**不绑机器**。

## 平台

装在任意支持 DSH 的载体上，**不绑定桌面端**。

# dsh-hard-delete

> **仓库**：<https://github.com/qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete>
> **许可**：AGPL-3.0-only（+ 商业授权，见第九节） ｜ **版本**：v0.1.0 ｜ **类型**：cordis 插件（host + client 双半，零运行时依赖）

在 DSH 的侧边栏会话「…」菜单里加一行 **删除** —— 点一下就把这个会话**彻底删掉**：

- **不可恢复**：直接物理删除，不进回收站、没有回滚。
- **不设门槛**：不看「疑似还在活动」，不要求二次输入，只弹一次确认框（因为不可逆）。
- **当前会话也能删**：确认框会明确提示「这正是你当前打开的会话，删完请切换或刷新」。
- **删完整**：会话目录之外，还清掉指向它的 projcache 条目与 `workspace.json` 引用，
  避免留下悬空元数据。

> 与同机另一个插件 **`dsh-session-recycle`** 的分工：
> 那个是设置页里的「软删 → 回收站 → 恢复 / 回滚」，保守、可救回；
> 这个是菜单里的一键硬删。两者互不干扰（本插件不碰 `_recycle-bin/`）。

---

## 一、形态与注册

本插件**同时**声明 `dsh.bundle` 与 `dsh.client`，因此走 **bundle 层**注册：

```json
"dsh": {
  "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
  "client": { "inject": [], "platform": "web" }
}
```

> `dsh.client.inject` 刻意留空：本插件浏览器半只 `require("react")`（平台种子词）。
> 为什么不去 require 官方 UI 组件库，见第六节第 7 条。

> ⚠️ 只有 `dsh.client` 而**没有** `dsh.bundle` 的插件不能进 `dsh.profile.bundles` ——
> 宿主会以 `declares no dsh.bundle` 拒绝并**启动即崩**。本插件两个都声明了，所以不受此限。

装到某个 profile：

```bash
# 方式 A（推荐）：让 DSH 自己装 —— 桌面端「插件 → 添加插件」里粘贴本仓地址，
#   或命令行（profile 名按你的实际环境改）：
dsh plugin --profile web add qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete

# 方式 B：声明式手工安装
#   在 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/package.json 里
#     dependencies:        { "dsh-hard-delete": "link:<本仓路径>" }
#     dsh.profile.bundles: 追加 "dsh-hard-delete"
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name> && pnpm install
# 重启 DSH
```

> 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness 桌面端）的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，
> 别用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …`（CLI 会直接拒绝）；桌面端请走「插件 → 添加插件」。

---

## 二、两个槽位

| 槽位 | 挂什么 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 菜单里的「删除」行（id `hard-delete`，order **500**，排在 archive 的 400 之后） | owner 注入 `{ sessionId, displayTitle }` 与 `useMenuOpenState` 钩子 |
| `shell.overlay` | 确认框 + 结果提示 | **必须挂在常驻浮层上**：确认框若挂在菜单项里，菜单一关它就跟着卸载了 |

菜单项只做一件事：把「待确认请求」写进模块级小 store，然后关掉菜单。
浮层里的对话框读同一个 store，所以在菜单卸载后依然活着。

界面**自绘**（官方 `MenuItemButton` / `Modal` / `Button` / `Toast` 拿不到，见第六节第 7 条），
但完全照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格来：`min-height:34px` / `padding:6px 8px` /
`gap:6px` / `border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-md)` / hover 用
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`，危险行用 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary` +
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover-danger`。DOM 也与官方同构：
`div > [role=separator] + button[role=menuitem]` —— 菜单的键盘遍历与焦点回收都是读 DOM 的，
自绘按钮同样能参与。每个 `var()` 都写了兜底值，主题变量缺失时不会变成透明。

---

## 三、host 半的路由

前缀可配（默认 `/api/dsh-hard-delete`），全部 **loopback-only + same-origin 校验**。

| 方法 | 路径 | 请求体 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/config` | — | 公开配置（`apiPrefix` / 文案覆盖 / 开关 / `configErrors`），**不含绝对路径** |
| POST | `/inspect` | `{sessionId}` | 一个会话的概况：标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数 / 有无线索日志 |
| POST | `/delete` | `{sessionId, confirm:true}` | **彻底删除**（不可逆） |

错误统一 `{ error, code }`。值得注意的 code：`session-not-found`(404)、
`confirm-required`(400)、`invalid-sessionId`(400)、`path-escape`(400)、
`loopback-only`(403)、`body-too-large`(413)。

返回列表里**不含任何绝对路径**——界面只显示标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数。

---

## 四、删一个会话要动几处

```
<DSH_HOME>/
├─ sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/
│  └─ session[.v<N>].jsonl[.zstd]        ← ① 整个目录物理删除（多版本日志一起）
├─ storages/
│  ├─ session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json  ← ② 新版：每会话一个文件
│  ├─ session_projcache.json                ← ③ 旧版：tables.sessions[<id>]
│  └─ workspace.json                        ← ④ archivedSessionIds / pinnedSessionIds
│                                              / tables.workspaces[*].sessionIds
└─ （浏览器那一边）
   └─ ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)   ← ⑤ 让侧边栏那一行立刻消失
```

安全性质：

- **路径纵深防御**：`sessionId` 必须是单层路径段（挡 `.` / `..` / 分隔符 / NUL），
  定位后再用 `relative()` 确认最终目录没跑出 `sessions/`。
- **只认精确路径**：只在 `sessions/<任意项目目录>/<精确的 sessionId>` 下动手，
  绝不复刻宿主的目录名编码规则（也就不会被规则变化带偏）。
- **不覆盖、不猜**：定位不到就是 404，什么都不做。
- **元数据清理失败不冒充删除失败**：降级成 `warnings` 如实回传，界面照实提示。
- **原子写 JSON**：先写 `.tmp-<pid>-<ts>` 再 rename，网络盘上失败也不留半个文件。
- **只读探测**：`/inspect` 全程不写盘。

---

## 五、七个实测踩出来的坑（本节是这份代码最有价值的部分）

1. **多帧 zstd：Node 的同步接口只解第一帧。** DSH 的会话日志是**多帧拼接**的。
   `zstdDecompressSync(整个文件)` 实测在 107 KB 的文件上只吐 187 字节（就第一帧），
   `zlib.createZstdDecompress()` 流也一样停在第一帧。必须按 magic `28 B5 2F FD`
   切帧、逐帧解。第一版没做这件事，标题/工作目录大面积读不出来。

2. **头部解码要「帧数 + 字节」双限。** 帧大小不固定（实测 1.5 KB ~ 35 KB 都有），
   只限帧数会漏后文，只限字节会白解一堆帧。两个都设，取先到的那个；
   并且 magic 也可能出现在压缩数据内部，解不开就跳过，靠 JSON 解析兜住误判。

3. **projcache 有两种布局，都得清。** 实测 `<home>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
   与 `<home>/storages/session_projcache.json` 的 `tables.sessions[<id>]` 同时存在。
   只清一种就会留下悬空条目。

4. **存在「空壳」会话目录。** 真实 `~/.dsh` 里有目录建了但没写成日志的会话
   （实测 15 个会话目录里有 1 个）。如果「必须扫到日志才算会话」，
   这类目录就永远删不掉。改成：**目录名精确等于 sessionId 就认**，
   日志有无只作为 `hasLog` 事实回传。

5. **侧边栏那一行不会自己消失 —— 但有一条现成的事件。**
   客户端 `ctx.sessions`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 client 半）
   通过 `ctx.remote.$on('api-session/added' | 'api-session/removed', …)` 维护会话列表；
   宿主侧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes` 把这批宿主 Cordis 事件原样转发给浏览器。
   所以删完文件只要 `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', sessionId)`，那一行立刻消失，
   不必等下一次 list 刷新，也不必自己去动客户端的列表状态。

6. **删除当前会话受 Windows 文件语义影响。** 宿主对日志文件是**持有句柄持续追加写**的。
   Node/libuv 打开文件时带 `FILE_SHARE_DELETE`，所以删除通常能成功（名字立刻消失），
   但宿主后台仍可能在写那个已经 unlink 的文件。因此确认框里明确写了
   「若它正在运行，建议删完重启一次 DSH」。

7. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 在浏览器里 require 不到。**
   浏览器端模块表里只有两类东西：平台种子词（react 一族）和**声明了 `dsh.client`
   的 Loader 条目**。primitives 两个都不是 —— 它没有 `dsh.client`，在插件树里也没有
   对应条目（实测 201 条 Loader 条目里没有它）；官方客户端插件是在**构建期**把它内联
   进自己 bundle 的。所以第三方插件要么自己上构建，要么自己画。本插件选择自己画，
   但严格照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格与主题变量来（见第二节）。
   推论：`dsh.client.inject` 里写一个不存在的包名不会报错（只是解析不到），
   真正会炸的是运行时的 `require` —— 所以本插件只 `require("react")`。

---

## 六、配置

`<DSH_HOME>/hard-delete.config.json`（可选；env 优先）。载入一次常驻，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。

```json
{
  "apiPrefix": "/api/dsh-hard-delete",
  "cleanMetadata": true,
  "emitRemovedEvent": true,
  "maxFiles": 20000,
  "headerFrames": 32,
  "headerScanBytes": 262144,
  "text": {}
}
```

env 覆盖：`DSH_HOME`、`HARD_DELETE_CONFIG`、`HARD_DELETE_API_PREFIX`。

`text` 段可按 key 覆盖界面文案（前端内置 zh 字典兜底；默认下发空表 = 不覆盖）。
`cleanMetadata:false` = 只删会话目录，留元数据；`emitRemovedEvent:false` = 不发那一行消失事件。

---

## 七、测试

```bash
node _test/test-host.mjs           # 39 项夹具断言，全在临时目录里跑，不碰真实会话
node _test/test-client.mjs         # 11 项客户端离线断言（最小 hooks 运行时跑一遍渲染）
node _test/smoke-real-readonly.mjs # 对真实 ~/.dsh 只读冒烟（不做任何写操作）
node _test/verify-e2e-copy.mjs     # 把真实 home 复制一份，走完整 HTTP 栈删一个真会话
```

夹具单测覆盖：多项目定位、版本号文件名、多帧 zstd 头部解码、两种 projcache 布局、
空壳目录、路径穿越、dryRun、workspace.json 引用清理、删除后 404、
loopback / Host / 跨站 / 跨源 / 405 / 非法 JSON / 413 / `confirm` 校验 /
`api-session/removed` 的发出与关闭开关。

客户端离线单测覆盖：factory 形态、**只 require `react`**、两个槽位的 id/order/locale、
文案 key 全部有兜底、菜单项 DOM 与官方同构且点击后关菜单并写入请求、
确认框三条警告齐全且默认焦点在「取消」、缺 slots API 时明确报错、
sessions 服务取不到时降级不炸。

`verify-e2e-copy.mjs` 是最后一道闸：真实会话目录里的多版本日志、真实 projcache
与 workspace.json，走完整链路删掉一个真会话后逐项核对，**真实库全程只读**。

---

## 八、明确不做的事（以及为什么）

- **不做回收站 / 回滚**：本插件就是「删掉」这一个动作。要可恢复请用 `dsh-session-recycle`。
- **不做活动守卫**：用户要的是「自由删除」，加守卫就回到了软删插件的语义。
  取而代之的是确认框里把风险讲清楚（不可恢复 / 当前会话 / 可能仍在写盘）。
- **不改主包的会话列表状态**：只发一个宿主事件，列表由客户端自己维护。
- **不碰宿主服务**：只 `inject: ['webServer']`，不 import 会话/工作区服务。
- **不返回绝对路径**：前端显示不了也不需要。

---

## 九、许可

**AGPL-3.0-only**（GNU Affero General Public License v3.0），全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

本项目管理在 **AGPL-3.0** 下开放：个人、学习、开源项目可自由使用与修改。
若需在 **闭源** 或 **商业场景** 中使用（不愿承接 AGPL 的传染条款），请联系获取**商业授权** ——
本仓暂无公开的联系邮箱，**请通过本仓 Issue 联系**。

本仓自 v0.1.0 起即为 AGPL-3.0，尚无许可变更历史。

本仓代码为**独立实现**：实现时观察了宿主公开的运行时约定（HTTP 路由注册方式 `ctx.webServer.register`、
客户端打包形态 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`、槽位注册 `ctx.slots.inject/register`、
磁盘布局与日志文件名、转发事件 allowlist）与官方 `Menu.module.css` 的公开样式规格；
**未复制任何第三方插件代码**。命名上刻意避开 npm 上已被占用的 `dsh-session-delete` / `dsh-session-recycle`。

---

## 十、发布与收录

- 发布流程、版本号策略与推送步骤见 [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md)；
  推送脚本 [scripts/push-publish.mjs](scripts/push-publish.mjs)（token 只从环境变量读，不落盘、不进 git 配置）。
- **远端只有 GitHub**：插件市场按 GitHub 仓库索引，Gitee 镜像对本仓没有收益，故不做。
- **插件市场收录**：[dshbase](https://dshbase.com/) 与 [DSH 插件市场](https://github.com/bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace)
  按 GitHub 仓库的 **`dsh-plugin` topic 自动索引**（每 2 小时扫一次）。本仓的 topic：
  `dsh-plugin` · `dsh` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis-plugin`。
- 市场按 `package.json` 的 `version` 判断更新；**发版必须 bump version**（见 CHANGELOG）。

plugins.description: Sign in to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other subscription model routes inside the DeepSeek Harness — the sign-in button the Harness never shipped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subscription-signin

[![tests](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

**The sign-in button the DeepSeek Harness never shipped.**

Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for — ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max,
GitHub Copilot, and more — as model routes inside the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Adds a
**Subscriptions** settings page plus a compact extension on every provider card
in **Settings → Models**.

```text
Settings → Subscriptions → ChatGPT (Codex) → [ Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex) ]
                                    ↓
                    github.com/login/device  ·  code ABCD-1234
                                    ↓
                    ✓ Signed in — draws on your plan
```

No password is ever collected or stored by this plugin. The vendor runs the
sign-in on its own page; the Harness credential store writes the token.

## Repository layout

The **installable package is the `dsh-subscription-signin/` directory.** The
tests, license and documentation sit beside it and are not part of the package:

```text
dsh-subscription-signin/   ← the package; this is what you install
  host.js                  ← the Host half (tool + HTTP route)
  client.js                ← the Client half (settings page + provider card)
  cordis.patch.yml         ← the accounts, as configuration
  locale/en.json           ← package metadata strings
  package.json
smoketest/                 ← five dependency-free suites (run from the root)
docs/FINDINGS.md           ← what was measured vs inferred
```

---

## Why this exists

The Harness already ships everything needed to *use* a subscription as a model
route. Its LLM adapter registers OAuth flows for eight providers — the transport
works, the token exchange works, the credential store works.

What it has no surface for is **starting** one. Nothing in the GUI or CLI ever
calls the authorization seam's `begin()`. This plugin is that missing surface.

It implements **no OAuth**. It does not touch PKCE, state, device codes, or token
parsing — all of that lives in `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, shipped by DeepSeek. This
plugin asks the Harness to begin a flow, shows you the URL and code, and reports
the result.

## Supported providers

Configured out of the box, driven through the Harness's own authorization seam:

| Provider | Credential | Login style |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT (Codex) | `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | device code |
| Claude (Pro/Max) | `llm-pi-ai/anthropic` | OAuth |
| GitHub Copilot | `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot` | device code |
| xAI | `llm-pi-ai/xai` | device code |
| Meta | `llm-pi-ai/meta` | device code |
| OpenRouter | `llm-pi-ai/openrouter` | OAuth + paste fallback |
| Radius | `llm-pi-ai/radius` | browser callback |
| Kimi For Coding | `llm-pi-ai/kimi-coding` | device code |

**Honest status.** Sign-in is verified end to end for **ChatGPT (Codex)** and
**Claude (Pro/Max)**; Claude's route was observed authenticating successfully and
then being rate-limited by the account (HTTP 429 with Anthropic's own
`request_id` — a quota answer, not a credential failure). Copilot's flow is
verified and completes. xAI, Meta, OpenRouter, Radius and Kimi hold credentials
that have been written successfully, but **no request has been served on those
routes in the session where this was verified**, so treat them as untested rather
than broken. `docs/FINDINGS.md` records what is measured versus inferred.

## Install

**Requirements.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later. Developed and verified
against `0.2.0-rc.2`, the release this plugin's two seams were checked on
(`ctx.authorization` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization`, and the client
`slots` service). Every Harness service it consumes is reached with a defensive
`ctx.get(...)` plus an undefined check, so a missing one degrades to a reported
message instead of a crash — but a Harness that has moved a seam will still need
a matching plugin release.

The plugin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this directory:

```text
install_bundle: link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subscription-signin
```

Or, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-subscription-signin"] } }
```

Then **restart DSH once.** This matters and is explained under
[Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) — the client half is composed into the
browser's boot graph at startup, so a freshly installed bundle has no page until
the process restarts.

## Use

From the GUI: **Settings → Subscriptions**, pick an account, press *Sign in*.

For an agent, or a headless harness, the same implementation is exposed as a tool
with actions `status`, `start`, `poll`, `cancel`, `signout`, `submitCode` and
`diagnostics`. Read `status` first; `start` returns the URL and, for device
grants, the code you enter on the vendor's page.

## Safety

This section is the reason to trust the plugin, so it is specific rather than
reassuring.

**It never sees a secret.** No password, token, API key or refresh token is read,
written, logged, or forwarded. The token is produced and stored by the Harness
credential seam (`ctx.authorization` / `ctx.credentials`), not by this code.
Audit it yourself — it is two files:

- **`host.js`** — zero imports. No filesystem access, no network requests, no
  child processes. It asks the credential store *whether* a record exists, and
  can delete one on explicit `signout` with `confirm: true`; it never reads a
  token value. The one `process.env` write is the documented per-account `env`
  field (used so a provider that selects its endpoint from the environment can be
  configured per account), and it is restored when the attempt settles.
- **`client.js`** — one dependency, `react`, supplied by the page. Its only
  `fetch` calls go to the plugin's own `/plugins/subscription-signin` route on
  your local Harness. Nothing is rendered from a credential.

**The one network-bearing route is trust-gated.** The panel reaches the Host half
over an HTTP route that inherits the Harness's own checks
(`connection.requestRejection`: Host/Origin validation and browser
authentication). On top of that, every mutating call must be a JSON `POST`, which
forces a CORS preflight and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `nosniff`.

**Not sanctioned by the vendors — read this.** For ChatGPT-plan usage, the
Harness targets the ChatGPT/Codex backend
(`chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`), which OpenAI's developer documentation tells
third-party apps not to target for plan usage. **This plugin surfaces behaviour
the Harness already ships; it does not introduce it and cannot change it.** The
sanctioned path for third-party apps is *Sign in with ChatGPT*, which the Harness
does not implement. Using a subscription outside a vendor's intended client may
conflict with that vendor's terms, and vendors may rate-limit or block such
traffic. You are choosing to do that with your own account. Do not use this to
resell access, and do not use it to reach credentials that are not yours.

**No credentials are in this repository.** If you ever find one here, that is a
bug — please open an issue. The repository was scanned for tokens, private keys,
home paths and email addresses before its first commit. `docs/FINDINGS.md` does
cite exact package versions and source symbols from the Harness, which is
deliberate: a claim about a specific build is only useful if it names the build.

**Found a vulnerability?** Report it privately via
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue. That file also lists what
is and is not in scope — worth reading first, because the unofficial-backend
caveat above is a documented trade-off rather than a defect, and the two are easy
to confuse.

## Configuration

Accounts are configured, not hardcoded. They live in this package's own
[`cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-subscripti

plugins.description: Coding Plan quota pill for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web composer dock: monthly cycle usage in USD and the rolling 5-hour window, read with the credential your ctrip model provider already uses.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-coding-plan-balance 把 **Coding Plan 余额**做成 DSH Web 界面里输入框下方的一枚常驻胶囊：本计费周期的已用 / 限额（USD）、使用百分比，以及滚动 5 小时窗口的用量。 凭据复用你 profile 里 `ctrip` 模型 provider 的同一条 API Key；密钥只留在 Host 进程，页面只拿到额度数字。 ``` ◔ 50 美金 · $0.13 / $50.00 · 0% · 5h $0.00 / $50.00 ``` [中文](#中文) · [English](#english) · [MIT](LICENSE) --- ## 中文 ### 特性 - **常驻输入框下方**：注册进 `conversation.composer.dock`，与 DSH 自带的 activity / usage 两个胶囊并排，不占对话区域。 - **一眼看到三件事**：套餐名 · 周期已用/限额 · 使用百分比 · 5 小时窗口用量。 - **悬停看细节**：套餐状态、周期已用/限额/百分比、剩余额度、重置时间、5h 窗口结束时间、本次读取时间。 - **点击刷新**（强制取最新），平时按 Host 下发的间隔（默认 60s）自动轮询；轮询走 Host 的复用窗口，多个会话同时看也只多打一次上游请求。 - **失败不消失**：未配置 Key、网络不通、额度被阻断时，胶囊留在原位并显示原因，数字改用主题的警告/错误色。 - **同样的能力给 agent**：注册 `coding_plan_balance` 工具，可以直接问"还剩多少额度"。 - **主题与语言**：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token（自动跟随明/暗），文案走 Client locale（中 / 英）。 ### 安装 任选一种（都是 DSH 自带的插件安装路径）： 1. **Web GUI**：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件，填 `https://github.com/zq0929/dsh-coding-plan-balance` 2. **命令行**：`dsh plugin add https://github.com/zq0929/dsh-coding-plan-balance` 3. **本地开发**：克隆到本地后，在"添加插件"里填目录绝对路径，装完直接改源码即可（`index.js` 改动跟随 Loader 重组，`client.js` 改动跟随 Client 模块图）。 安装后需要**刷新页面**让浏览器侧模块生效。 ### 凭据 插件不新增任何密钥配置，默认复用 profile 里 `ctrip` provider 用的那条 Key： 1. `config.apiKey`（显式配置，优先级最高）； 2. `ctx.credentials.resolve(config.apiKeyEnv)` —— 覆盖进程环境变量、provider 管理的凭据库、`.env`，默认名 `CTRIP_API_KEY`； 3. `process.env[config.apiKeyEnv]`。 如果你的 provider 用的是别的变量名，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成那个名字即可。要求该 token 已绑定生效套餐。 ### 配置 在你自己 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按行 id 覆盖（profile 层在 bundle 层之后应用）： ```yaml - id: coding-plan-balance config: apiKeyEnv: MY_CTRIP_KEY refreshSeconds: 120 ``` | 字段 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | `https://ada-cli-go.ctripcorp.com` | Coding Plan API 主域名 | | `fallbackBaseUrl` | `http://ada-cli-golang.ctripcorp.com` | 主域名不可达时回退；留空关闭回退 | | `apiKeyEnv` | `CTRIP_API_KEY` | 凭据名 | | `apiKey` | 空 | 显式密钥，优先于 `apiKeyEnv` | | `refreshSeconds` | `60` | 页面轮询间隔，小于 20 按 20 处理 | | `cacheSeconds` | `10` | Host 端快照复用窗口：不带 `refresh` 的读取在此窗口内复用同一份快照；并发读取一律合并成一次上游请求 | | `timeoutMs` | `8000` | 单次上游请求超时 | | `routePath` | `/api/coding-plan.balance` | 页面读取额度用的 Host 路由（必须以 `/api/` 开头） | | `tool` | `true` | 是否注册 `coding_plan_balance` 工具 | ### 工作原理 - **Host 半**（[index.js](index.js)）：解析凭据 → 调 `/api/coding-plan/quota/me`、`/api/coding-plan/5h-usage`、`/api/user/api-tokens/userinfo`（周期配额必需，另两个尽力而为）→ 归一化成一个快照 → 通过 `ctx.connection.fetch.register()` 挂在 `/api/coding-plan.balance`。鉴权、Host/Origin 校验、浏览器会话 cookie 都由 Connection 统一处理，未携带会话的请求得到 401。 - **Client 半**（[client.js](client.js)）：用 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 注册懒工厂，通过 `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.composer.dock')` 挂一枚胶囊，以文档相对路径拉取 `api/coding-plan.balance`，按 `refreshSeconds` 轮询，点击立即 `?refresh=1`。 - **一份实现两个调用方**：UI 点击和 agent 工具走同一条读取路径，工具结果是同一份快照，不存在两套逻辑。 ### 已知限制 - 只读个人额度：团队套餐详情、团队 AI 代码统计这两类接口需要更大权限范围，本插件不调用。 - 5 小时窗口在 `source: none`（还没有产生费用、没有活动窗口）时，接口返回的窗口时间只是兜底展示值，插件因此不显示"窗口结束"。 - 需要能访问 `*.ctripcorp.com`（内网或代理）。 - 少数接口字段语义依赖上游：`limit_usd` 为 0 表示未配置限额，此时显示"不限"。 - 本仓库只做静态校验（语法、清单、id 一致性、语言文件、图标），没有浏览器视觉回归。 ### 开发 ```sh node --check index.js node --check client.js node scripts/check.mjs ``` 仓库自检脚本会核对：包名、`dsh.bundle.patch`、`exports`/`files` 覆盖的文件、`client.js` 的模块 id 与包名一致、`cordis.patch.yml` 行名与包名一致、中英语言文件的 `meta.title`/`meta.description`、图标是 `

plugins.description: Add a Delete Session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, removing the Session log and its projection cache.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

Add a **Delete Session** action to the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH)
sidebar. Choosing it permanently removes the Session's stored log and its projection cache, and
drops the sidebar row without a page reload.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This project was written by AI.** The code, this README, and every other file in this
> repository were produced by an AI coding agent (see [AI authorship](#ai-authorship)). It was
> reviewed and tested against a real DSH install before publication, but you should treat it as
> AI-generated software: read the source before you run it, and expect rough edges outside the
> paths that were exercised.

---

## Why this plugin exists

DSH has no API for deleting a Session. As of the versions this was built against:

| Candidate | What it actually does |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionController` (Host `ctx.remote.session`) | `resolveAgent` / `inspect` / `list` / `search` / `create` / `selectModel` / `rename` / `fork` / `prompt` / `cancel` / `page` / `projections` — **no delete** |
| `sessionPersistence` | `create` / `open` / `flush` / `stat` / `list` — an append-only log, **no delete** |
| `workspaceRegistry.delete(id)` | Deletes a *Workspace registration* while deliberately retaining the directory and **every Session log** |
| `sessions` (client) | `retain` / `using` / `refreshProjections` / `search` / `fork` / `scope` / `binding` — **no delete** |

So the only way to offer the feature is to compose the official seams in the right order. This
plugin does exactly that, and nothing else.

## How it works

The Host half registers one loopback route, `POST /plugins/session-delete/delete`, and the browser
half adds a row to each Session's `...` menu that calls it.

Deletion runs as five steps:

1. **Stop the Session** — `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`. This is
   the official "stop this Session's activity" path; it fans out `workspace/session-stop`, which
   `dsh-agent`, `dsh-jobs`, `dsh-schedule` and `dsh-subagent` all listen to.
2. **Detach the live Session** — `ctx.sessions.store.get(id).detach()`. The store keeps entries in
   a non-public map, and calling the entry's own `detach` is the single seam that raises
   `session/disposed`.
3. **Remove the sidebar row** — `session/disposed` → `api-session/removed`
   (`dsh-api-session-controller`) → `ctx.remote.$on("api-session/removed", …)` on the client. That
   chain is the only reason the row disappears without a reload.
   A **cold** Session (one restored from disk that was never opened in this process) has no store
   entry, so `detach` cannot fire. For that case the plugin emits `api-session/removed` itself —
   the same signal, by the same name. Nothing on the Host listens for that event, so this is
   side-effect free.
4. **Forget the membership** — `detachSession` on every Workspace, plus `unarchiveSession` and
   `unpinSession`, so no archived or pinned ghost survives.
5. **Remove the bytes** — the artifact directory under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<id>/`
   and the projection cache at `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`.

The SQLite session index is *derived* from persistence state, so it converges on its own during the
next reconcile — the plugin does not touch it.

### Files touched on disk

Everything the plugin removes lives under `$DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`):

```
$DSH_HOME/
  sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/session.v4.jsonl[.zstd]   <- removed
  storages/session_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json         <- removed
  storages/workspace.json                                       <- membership updated in place
```

## Install

The plugin installs as a **profile bundle**, using DSH's own plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

From a local checkout instead of a git host:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add C:\path\to\dsh-session-delete
```

Use the profile you actually launch DSH with (`web` is the DSH Desktop default, and is also what
`dsh plugin …` assumes when you omit `--profile`). `dsh` is a shim into the packaged CLI, placed on
`PATH` once DSH Desktop has been started at least once.

> [!NOTE]
> **The repository must be public for the `github:` shorthand.** pnpm probes the HTTPS URL first and
> only falls back to SSH when that probe fails, which is what happens for a private repository or a
> nonexistent one. On a machine where outbound SSH (port 22) is blocked, that fallback fails with
> `ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Connection refused`. For a private repository, use an
> explicit HTTPS spec and let git's credential helper authenticate:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git
> ```

Then reload the DSH page in your browser so it picks up the browser bundle, and open a Session's
`...` menu in the sidebar. **DSH itself does not need restarting.**

To update after new commits land, re-run the same command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

Re-running `add` *is* the update path: pnpm re-resolves the ref, and a changed shipped file lands in
a new content-addressed store directory, so DSH imports a **new module URL** and the Host half
genuinely reloads. See [Host reload semantics](#host-reload-semantics).

To remove it again:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-delete
```

That prunes the dependency, drops the name from `dsh.profile.bundles`, and unloads both halves —
verified live: the route stops answering and the browser bundle leaves the client-module graph.

> [!NOTE]
> For a **local-path** install the profile entry is a `link:`, and pnpm was observed to leave the
> symlink at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete` behind after a `remove`.
> It is inert, but delete it by hand if you want the tree clean. Git installs are unaffected.

### What `dsh plugin add` actually does

`dsh plugin` is a thin front end for pnpm: it forwards its arguments to pnpm **inside the profile
directory** (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/`). The part that makes the plugin load is what DSH does
next — it reconciles the profile manifest and, for every dependency that was just added and declares
a `dsh.bundle.patch`, appends its package name to `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json, after the add
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-delete": "git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "…existing bundles…",
        "dsh-session-delete"        // <- appended by the add
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

`dsh.profile.bundles` is the **only** thing that decides what loads. That array is why one command
is sufficient and no `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

A dependency that declares no `dsh.bundle` is installed as a plain dependency and skipped, with a
warning:

```
dsh: warning: <name> declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer
```

The bundled [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) is the patch this profile layer reads:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: 'dsh-session-delete'
```

`name` is the **package name**, not a path — the profile resolves it from its own `node_modules`.

> [!NOTE]
> `client.js` registers itself under the name `dsh-session-delete`, which must stay
> **character-for-character identical** to `name` in `package.json`. client-modules derives the
> browser bundle's id from the enclosing `package.json` and rejects a bundle that registers under
> anything else — and the only symptom is a menu row that silently never appears.

## Host reload semantics

Node's ESM registry caches modules by **resolved URL** and offers no invalidation hook. That has one
practical consequence:

> **Editing an installed `host.js` in place does not take effect in a running DSH.**

How much that bites depends on how you installed:

- **From git**, pnpm copies the package into its content-addressed store. A changed file produces a
  new store dire

plugins.description: Profile-level skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: a flat skill inventory with enable/disable, discovery diagnostics and a restorable trash, in a sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-mgr

**Every skill in one list** — the whole profile inventory in a sidebar panel: see what is installed, read a skill's body, enable or disable it, repair a discovery problem, and delete it into a trash you can restore from.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/releases)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> If this plugin saves you a hunt through `~/.dsh/skills`, a ⭐ star helps the next person find it.

## Why this exists

A skill is a folder with a discovery file in it, which is easy to create and hard to keep track of: which ones exist, which are currently switched off (a renamed file is invisible, not absent), which one has a broken frontmatter, and which are duplicates across the two writable roots. This plugin is the one place that answers those questions, without an editor open and without hand-renaming files.

**Enabled is the default, and disabling is a filesystem fact first.** The discovery file is renamed (`SKILL.md` → `SKILL.md.disabled`, or `<name>.md` → `<name>.md.disabled`) so the filesystem provider simply stops seeing it; a registry record is what lets the panel still list it and switch it back on.

## Screenshots

![The Skills panel: the flat profile inventory](docs/images/skills-panel.png)

*Skills — one flat table over the profile inventory (enabled and disabled alike), with search, a source filter, use-count and last-used chips, the discovery diagnostics and the restorable trash.*

![The detail view of one skill](docs/images/skill-detail.png)

*Inspect — the skill's body and metadata, with the enable/disable action for a disabled skill.*

## The registry file

```
<profile>/.dsh/dshsk/skills.json      the profile's skill management state
```

One registry holds everything the manager persists: the disabled-skill records, the trash, and the statistics checkpoint. It is reconciled at startup — a `.disabled` file with no record is adopted (an upgraded or hand-edited install), and a record whose file is gone is dropped. Writes go through an atomic same-directory temp file (`wx`, mode `0600`, then `rename`), and a read that hits unparsable JSON refuses to overwrite it and reports why.

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row | sits directly under **Plugins** (`order: 1`) and opens the **Skills** page in the centre column |
| Skills table | one flat table of the profile inventory — Name / Source / Description / Status / Actions — with search, sorting and a source filter |
| Enable / disable | renames the discovery file and keeps the record, so the row stays visible (dimmed) and can be switched back on |
| Inspect | reads a skill's body and metadata without leaving the GUI |
| Add skill | scaffolds a new skill in a writable root |
| Discovery diagnostics | lists the skills the provider cannot see, and auto-fixes the repairable ones in place |
| Restorable trash | `Delete` moves a skill into the root's `.trash`; the panel lists it with a Restore action, and clearing the trash is explicit |
| Chat `/` menu dots | marks each candidate row as model-invocable or user-invocable, coloured from the same settings the panel reads |
| Settings card | the plugin's own configuration, in the Plugins manager |
| Attribution | the title chip carries the installed version and the author credit |

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` installation (the plugin composes into a profile)
- `pnpm` 11.8.0 (`packageManager` in the manifest pins it)

## Installation

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                        # typecheck → build → tests → verifiers
pnpm pack                         # dist/dsh-skill-mgr-<version>.tgz
sh tools/install-into-profile.sh desktop
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards; the sidebar entry appears directly under **Plugins**.

The package is not on npm: the profile installs it from this repository. `dsh plugin` (a pnpm passthrough into the profile directory) is what the script uses, and the Plugins page does the same thing. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh --profile desktop` itself refuses to compose it, while `dsh plugin` still works.

Upgrading from `dsh-skill-hub`? The two packages must not both be installed — they would both claim the plugin-config card. Remove the old bundle first; the new plugin adopts the old state file on its first load and leaves it untouched.

## Quick start

1. Open **Skills** in the sidebar. The table lists every skill in `~/.dsh/skills` and `~/.agents/skills`.
2. Search for a skill; select **Inspect** to read it, or **Disable** to switch it off for the whole profile.
3. Select **Add skill** to scaffold a new one in a writable root.
4. Read the diagnostics banner when something is not being discovered, and use its fix action on the repairable entries.

## Configuration

The Loader entry's config is the settings card; the host reads the same values through their volatile refs.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | contribute the skill provider and the announcement; the management panel keeps working either way, because it is the surface that turns the plugin back on |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | register the system-prompt section that tells an agent this manager exists |
| `showUseCount` | `true` | per-skill invocation-count chip |
| `showUseTime` | `true` | per-skill last-used relative time |
| `dotModelColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "model-invocable" dot, in the table and the chat `/` menu |
| `dotUserColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "user-invocable only" dot |
| `statsWindowDays` | `14` | rolling window for the counts; `0` = all history |
| `statsScanMinutes` | `5` | background session-log scan interval, in minutes |

## Remote surface

The browser half reads and writes through one Typert Remote namespace, `skillMgr`. Two conventions cover the whole surface: `snapshot()` is the one read (the panel loads all of its slices from a single call, cached for one render pass), and every write answers `SkillApplyResult` (`{ok:true}` / `{ok:false, error}`) after which the caller refetches.

| Area | Methods |
|---|---|
| Core | `snapshot` |
| Profile inventory | `saveGlobalSkill`, `removeGlobalSkill`, `setGlobalSkillEnabled`, `skillDetail`, `fixDiagnostic`, `skillStats` |
| Trash | `restoreTrashedSkill`, `clearTrash` |

Nine methods in total. Their parameter and result types live in `src/wire.ts` as zod schemas, and each type is `z.infer` of its schema, so the host implementation, the descriptors and the browser half cannot drift apart.

## Caveats

- **Enable/disable is profile-wide, not per workspace.** Because toggling renames one discovery file, there is no way to have a skill on in one workspace and off in another; every workspace is offered every skill in the profile inventory. A reader who needs per-workspace on/off cannot have it here.
- **Project skills are discovered, not managed.** The provider lists a workspace's own roots so an agent still sees the skills beside it, but they are never part of the profile inventory the panel manages: they cannot be toggled, deleted or adopted. Onl

plugins.description: Agent profiles for DSH: per-session persona, duties, avatar and long-term memory, injected as a system-prompt section.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-profiles —— 智能体配置

> **English summary** — Multiple AI agent profiles for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): role, avatar, personality, speaking style, ground rules and long-term memory — one global default, plus a per-conversation override with its own instructions and memory.
> **Install:** `dsh plugin add dsh-agent-profiles` (recommended, from npm). The tarball and from-source alternatives are in the 安装 / Install section below. Then restart DSH for the host half and reload the page for the client half.
> **Highlights:** choose the active profile, pin a profile per conversation, memory-injection toggle, import / export, restore defaults.
> **Language:** the settings UI follows the host language setting — Chinese and English dictionaries are both built in. **Model-facing prompts stay in Chinese** by design.
> **License:** MIT.

多套 AI 智能体配置：**角色设定 / 性格特点 / 说话习惯 / 行为准则 / 长期记忆摘要 / 记忆条目**。

两层作用范围：

| 层           | 在哪改            | 作用范围                                  |
| ----------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| **全局当前配置**  | 设置 →「智能体配置」    | 没做专属设定的对话都用它                          |
| **每个对话的配置** | 输入框左侧下拉 + ⚙ 面板 | 只影响这一个对话；可固定某套配置，还能写**本对话专属**的补充设定与记忆 |

无论哪一层，切换都是**立即生效且只影响之后的对话**，历史记录一个字都不动。

## 安装 / Install

**✅ 推荐 / Recommended —— 从 npm 安装（用包名，不要手抄 tarball 地址）：**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-agent-profiles
```

*装完按提示重启 DSH；客户端那一半刷新页面即可生效。*
*Restart DSH when prompted; reload the page for the client half.*

### 备选方式 / Alternatives

**① tarball —— 直接装打包文件 / install the packed tarball**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-agent-profiles/-/dsh-agent-profiles-0.7.0.tgz
```

**② 源码 —— clone 后把本地目录链接进 profile / from source: clone and link the folder**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MoYu-CN/dsh-agent-profiles.git
dsh plugin add "link:<你的目录>/dsh-agent-profiles"
```

`link:` 不拷贝、直接软链，改代码立刻生效 —— 适合要改插件本身的场景。
`link:` symlinks instead of copying, so local edits take effect immediately — use it when you want to modify the plugin itself.

## 界面

### 设置 →「智能体配置」

![设置页](docs/settings-page.png)

*设置页：左栏配置列表（新建 / 复制 / 导入 / 导出），右栏编辑名称、头像与角色设定。*
*The settings page: the profile list on the left, and the name / avatar / role fields on the right.*

### 输入框左侧的快速切换器

![快速切换器](docs/quick-switcher.png)

*快速切换器：给**这个对话**挑一套配置 ——「跟随全局」表示用设置页里当前那一套。*
*The quick switcher: pick a profile for **this conversation**; "follow global" means the active profile from the settings page.*

### 回合头的头像与名称

![回合头](docs/message-header.png)

*回合头：本插件在官方「已完成 …」那一行**上方**加一行「[头像] 配置名」，官方那一行原样保留。*
*The turn head: this plugin adds an "[avatar] profile name" line **above** the stock "completed …" row, leaving that row untouched.*

### 长期记忆条目

![长期记忆](docs/memory-settings.png)

*长期记忆：逐条编辑**长期记忆条目**（每条自带「编辑 / 删除」），下方实时显示「长期记忆占用 746 / 5000 字；超过上限会自动提炼压缩」。*
*Long-term memory: edit the **long-term memory entries** one by one (each with its own edit / delete), with a live "long-term memory uses 746 / 5000 characters; past the cap it is condensed automatically" readout below.*

> 截图为**中文界面**下的实测界面（设置 UI 跟随宿主语言，内置中英两套词典）。
> The screenshots show the UI in Chinese (the settings UI follows the host language; both dictionaries ship built in).

---

## 1. 整体结构与模块划分

```
dsh-agent-profiles/
├── package.json          ── ① 包清单：bundle patch + dsh.client 声明 + meta/icon
├── cordis.patch.yml      ── ① 装配：插入 agent-profiles 行，硬依赖 webServer
├── icon.svg              ── ① 插件卡片图标
├── locale/zh.json,en.json── ② 元数据文案（宿主读插件卡片用）
└── lib/
    ├── store.js          ── ③ 数据模型 + 持久化 + 导入导出 + 变更算子
    ├── prompt.js         ── ④ 配置 → 注入文本（记忆开关、优先级声明、截断）
    ├── routes.js         ── ⑤ Host HTTP API（/__ap/*）+ index.html 脚本注入
    ├── index.js          ── ⑥ Host 入口：装配 store/prompt/routes + 注册提示词段落
    └── client.js         ── ⑦ 浏览器半：设置页（分栏）+ 输入框快速切换器
```

### 数据流

```
                       ┌──────────────── Host 进程 ────────────────┐
  设置页 / 快速切换器   │                                            │
   （浏览器）           │   routes.js  /__ap/state   /__ap/command   │
        │  fetch        │      │            /__ap/preview  /__ap/export
        └──────────────►│      ▼                                     │
                        │   store.js ──► profiles.json（原子写）      │
                        │      │                                     │
                        │      │  每次组装提示词时现算                │
                        │      ▼                                     │
                        │   prompt.js ──► systemPrompt.section(      │
                        │                   text: () => renderActive)│
                        └────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                         │
                                         ▼
                              模型看到的本轮系统提示词
```

### 为什么这么切

| 模块          | 单独成层的理由                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `store.js`  | 「配置长什么样、存哪、坏了怎么办」的生命周期是**磁盘**；与「怎么渲染成提示词」「怎么传给界面」完全不同步 |
| `prompt.js` | 这是**产品文案**层：段落顺序、空字段省略、记忆开关、截断说明都会随反馈反复改；改它不该碰到数据与传输代码 |
| `routes.js` | 传输与鉴权（同源守卫、体积上限、方法限制）是一组独立关注点，与业务算子分开才好测               |
| `index.js`  | 只做装配与降级（缺服务时怎么办），本身不含业务规则                              |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半必须自包含：不能 require 任何 Harness Client 包（见下）           |

---

## 2. 关键设计决策

### ① 提示词段落交的是「函数」，不是「字符串」

```js
systemPrompt.section({
  name: "agent-profiles:persona",
  order: 860,
  text: () => renderActive(store),   // ← 每次组装现算
});
```

字符串在注册那一刻就定死了，之后切换配置不会生效（重复注册同名段落会抛错）。  
交函数则**每次组装读一次当前的 activeId**，于是：

- 切换配置 ⇒ 下一次组装就是新配置 ⇒ **立即生效**；
- 历史消息存在会话日志里，本插件从不写它 ⇒ **历史不受影响**。

这两条不是顺手做到的，是把渲染做成函数直接换来的性质。

### ② `systemPrompt` 不进 `inject`，走 `ctx.get()` 软探测

硬依赖的语义是「缺了就整个插件停在 pending」。缺 `systemPrompt` 会让**设置界面也不出现**，  
用户连「为什么没有界面」都无从判断。所以：注入是增强，界面是本体，本体不该被增强拖死。  
（`webServer` 是硬依赖 —— 没它连界面都发不出去。）

### ③ 「每个对话一套」靠 **agent 作用域的同名段落**，不靠全局开关

全局段落只知道全局配置 —— 它拿不到「现在在跟哪个对话说话」。所以每个对话要有一个  
挂在该 agent 自己 ctx 上的段落：

```js
ctx.on("agent/created", ({ agent }) => {          // agent.id 就是 sessionId
  agentCtx.effect(() => systemPrompt.section({
    name: "agent-profiles:persona",                // ← 与全局段落**同名**
    order: 860,
    text: () => renderForSession(store, sessionId),
  }));
});
```

官方规则是「作用域段落压过同名全局段落」，于是：

- 有 agent 作用域段落 ⇒ 用**这个对话**的绑定与专属设定；
- 没有（非 agent 组装、或 `agent.ctx` 拿不到）⇒ 回落到全局段落的全局配置。

`agent/created` 是 **await 的**（早于第一步组装），所以注册一定赶在第一次注入之前完成；  
拿不到 `agent.ctx` 时**只降级 + 记一条 warning，绝不抛错** ——  
那个事件抛错会让 **agent 创建失败**，比「本对话设定没生效」严重得多。

两层各自的组装次数都会记进诊断（`本对话段 SN 次 / 全局兜底段 GN 次`），  
设置页能直接看到 —— 「每个对话独立注入」不是靠信念，是靠这个计数。

### ④ 出厂默认就带着一套准则

默认启用的「通用助手」是**填好内容**的（用户明确要求）：实事求是、简洁直白、不猜想臆想、  
服从现行的 AI 内容规范与平台审核要求、做没做好都如实说。出厂即生效 —— 新会话里默认助手  
就按这套说话，不用先手动配置。

> 早期版本这里是**刻意留空**的，理由是「装一个插件不该悄悄改变用户助手的行为」。  
> 用户看过实际效果后明确要求给默认助手写准则，于是**有意填上**。  
> 想回到零注入：把这一套的四个内容字段清空即可，`hasContent()` 会自动让它不进提示词  
> （注入与技能目录都会跳过它）。  
> 测试里把「默认准则必须含这五条」钉成了断言 —— 谁清空，谁就要面对红灯。

### ④c 长期记忆的自动化：工具 + 每 5 回合后台提炼 + 超限压缩

用户选择的是**两者都要**：模型能主动存，插件再定期兜底。

```
① 工具 memory_save      模型觉得值得长期记住 → 当场写进「本对话生效的那套配置」
② 后台提炼（每 5 回合）  插件读对话 → 调一次模型 → 把要点存进去
③ 超限压缩             长期记忆 > 5000 字 → 调模型合并成「摘要 + 精简条目」
```

**触发点**是 `agent/status` 变成 `idle`（一个回合跑完）——  
不能挂 `running`，那是回合**开始**，内容还没产生。

**写入目标**按会话 id **当场解析**（会话绑定优先，否则全局当前），  
绝不缓存「当前配置 id」：用户在对话中途切换配置时，缓存会把记忆写错地方。

**为什么压缩必须由插件做、不能交给模型自觉**：模型不知道「记忆满了」。  
预算判断只能由持有数据的一方做。

**四条硬约束（每条都对应一种「把会话弄坏」的形态，都有测试）**：

1. **绝不抛错到调用方**。后台跑的代码，任何异常都不该影响用户正在进行的对话；  
   所有对外调用包 try/catch，失败只记日志。
2. **绝不并发**。同一会话同一时刻只跑一次；否则两次跑起来会重复写同一批记忆。
3. **输入必须有上限**。送进模型的对话摘录截断到 6000 字 —— 那是用户的钱。
4. **输出必须能解析**。要求模型「一行一条」，**不用 JSON**：JSON 一旦格式跑偏整批丢失，  
   行文本最坏只是存进一条废话。压缩结果为空时**保持原样**，绝不冒险覆盖。

**缺服务要在装载时就说清楚**（缺 `sessionQuery` / `llm` / `tools` 各一条告警）：  
静默跳过的现象是「功能好像没生效」，用户分不清是没触发还是没能力。

**顺带修掉的一个真 bug**：`ProfileStore.command()` 原来只回传 `notice`，  
把算子自己的附加字段（`memory.autoAdd` 的 `added`）丢了 ——  
现象是「记忆明明存进去了，日志和诊断里却什么都没有」。现在附加字段原样带出。

### ④b 空配置不注入、且记忆关闭时整块消失

只起了个名字的配置不产生注入（`hasContent()`）。  
关闭记忆注入时是**整块不出现**，而不是出现「（记忆已关闭）」——后者仍占上下文，  
还会暗示模型「有记忆但你看不到」，让它开始猜记忆内容，比不注入更糟。

### ⑤ 客户端不 require 任何 Harness Client 包

官方 `practices.md` 明令禁止：那些包随版本变化、plain-JS 无类型检查，  
一个抛错的组件会**清空整个插槽条目**。所以控件全部自己写，样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` token

plugins.readme_text:
# TimeMirror for DSH · Workload Report

> **See your effort and your token spend on the same picture** — by **date** and by **workspace**: a calendar heatmap, time-of-day analysis, workspace share, model usage, and a **one-click self-contained HTML report** you can send straight to a client.
> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. Current version: **0.6.6**.

> TimeMirror is a macOS time-distribution app I published on the Mac App Store; this plugin brings the same idea to AI-assisted work. The package/repo keeps the descriptive name `dsh-workload-report` so it can be found in the DSH ecosystem; the brand stays TimeMirror.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workload-report?style=flat-square&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workload-report)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/actions)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)

[中文](./README.zh-CN.md) · English

## What it is

DSH shows stats for the **current session**. This plugin adds the cross-session, cross-project, cross-time view: which dates and which workspaces your effort went to, which hours you were productive, which models consumed the tokens, and what it cost — plus a static report for clients, teammates or monthly reviews.

**Not only cost, but the work behind it.** Active time, active days and turns show what you actually did; tokens and estimated cost show what it consumed. Numbers use the same definitions everywhere, so the dashboard and the exported report agree.

## Install & entry point

```bash
# npm (published package)
dsh plugin add dsh-workload-report

# or straight from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tableau-China/dsh-workload-report#main

# or link a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
```

Restart the Web profile after installing. The entry appears at the **bottom of the sidebar**: **Workload report** (**工作量报告** in Chinese). The built client bundle (`lib/client.js`) is committed, so installing from GitHub/npm needs no local build.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workload-report`.

## Data sources & principles

- **Official interfaces only.** Session identity comes from `sessionQuery.listSessions()`; statistics come from the official projections (`sessionProjections`, `sessionProjectionCache`) and, when needed, the official `sessionQuery.observeSession()` cold read. Model and hourly-token dimensions use the official `sessionQuery.readSession()` event log.
- **No storage-format parsing.** The plugin never opens `*.jsonl.zstd`, never parses zstd/JSONL, and never reads the harness's internal projection-cache files. Formats can change between releases; the official seams are the contract.
- **Zero outbound requests by default.** All statistics stay on your machine. The plugin exposes read-only HTTP routes only, and writes exactly one file: its own local index at `<DSH_HOME>/workload-report/index-v7.json` (safe to delete; it rebuilds).
- **The single opt-in exception** is the optional balance chip (`balance.enabled: true`, off by default), where the **host** calls the official `deepseekAccount` service. See [Privacy](#privacy).
- **No invented numbers.** Unreadable legacy sessions are excluded and counted in the UI; models without an official price show **—** instead of a made-up cost.

## Features (0.6.6)

- **Eight KPIs**: cumulative active time (**net active**, waiting shown on a second line), total tokens (full integer you can verify), model cost, active days, conversations, turns / steps, cache-read share, and the most active model.
- **Daily usage trend**: calendar heatmap (Mon–Sun × Year-Week, colour and bar height = active time) or a bar chart; weekends use a different colour, the peak bar is always labelled, and every calendar cell, bar, weekday total and axis label has its own tooltip.
- **Time of day**: bars default to **token output** (switchable to **turns**); the dots above the bars show **human-message density**. Peak bars are highlighted and labelled; the legend sits on one row.
- **Workspace share**: Top 6 + others donut, switchable between **time** and **tokens**.
- **Model token share**: a compact donut on the dashboard; full model details live in the next tab.
- **Model usage tab**: treemap (area = token share, Top 8 + others), stacked daily trend (Top 6 models), a detail table (share / requests / input / output / cache read / cache-hit rate / estimated cost), metric chips (Token / requests / model time), click-to-filter, and official pricing links. Costs are estimated only for models with official public prices.
- **Top sessions and daily detail**: ratio bars in the main numeric columns (sessions: turns / steps / active / output; daily detail: conversations / turns / active / tokens) and sortable headers on the sessions table; the daily detail table covers the last 31 days.
- **Export a self-contained HTML report**: one file with inline CSS and inline SVG, **no scripts and no external assets**; light/dark themes, custom title/note, optional `anonymize=1` to hide workspace names and session titles. The report mirrors the dashboard: 8 KPIs, calendar + bars, hourly density dots + turns mini-chart, ratio bars, and the same definitions. Only official pricing pages are linked.
- **Theme and locale aware**: all colours use host theme tokens (`--dsw-*`), so the dashboard follows the harness light/dark theme; all UI strings are aligned between Chinese and English.

## Screenshots

**By date**: eight KPIs + calendar heatmap + time-of-day analysis with human-message density dots + workspace share

![dashboard by date](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/dashboard-calendar.png)

**By workspace**: effort on the left, token spend on the right, both bars share one scale

![dashboard by workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/dashboard-workspace.png)

**The exported report**: one self-contained file, safe to send to a client

![report light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/report-light.png)

<details>
<summary>Dark-theme report</summary>

![report dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/report-dark.png)

</details>

## Metric definitions

The full definitions live in **[docs/metrics.md](./docs/metrics.md)**. Durations use one language-neutral `H / M / S` format (like K/M/B for tokens). The points users misread most:

### Active time

- **Active time = model time + tool time − waiting for user.** It is **cumulative engine work**, not wall-clock time; concurrent sessions and subagents each add up. It is not the elapsed time you sat in front of the screen.
- **Waiting for user** is split out as `waitMs` and excluded from active time. The same value is persisted with the index. The official `totals.activeMs` is kept for cross-checking: `netActiveMs + waitMs === activeMs` (±1 ms).
- **Three-layer wait rule** (a tool interval is treated as waiting only when it lasts at least `waitMinMs` **and** meets either condition):
  1. the tool name is in `waitTools` (default `ask_user_question`, `exit_plan_mode`);
  2. a `user/message` arrives between `tool/call` and `tool/result` (any tool).
- **Long-task exemption**: a long build/test tool that is not a wait tool and has no interleaved user message still counts as work. Short interactions below `waitMinMs` are not removed, to avoid fragmenting real work.
- Set `excludeWait: false` to disable the whole rule (behaviour matches 0.6.0).

### Time of day

The dashboard card has **two measures** and a third visual layer:

- **Tokens (default)**: each `assistant/message` usage is bucketed by the **message time** into the selected time zone. The sum of the 24 hour buckets equals the session's official token total (integer rescaling when the event tota
